cases.case_label: ~6.1-kb L1 in SLCO1B3 intron 5 (Japanese Rotor haplotype)
cases.mechanism_detail: Homozygous ~6.1-kb L1 in SLCO1B3 intron 5 causes transcripts lacking exon 5 or exons 5-7 with premature stops; no OATP1B3 protein in liver. Disease requires the in-cis SLCO1B1 nonsense mutation on the same haplotype.
cases.quote: RNA analysis revealed that the L1 insertion induced deleterious splicing resulting in SLCO1B3 transcripts lacking exon 5 or exons 5-7 and containing premature stop codons.
